summary.text: Nima Kulkarni is a Democratic state representative from Kentucky House District 40 who has served since January 1, 2019, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026 after winning the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary. She is an attorney and founder of Indus Law Firm.

paragraphs.text: Nima Kulkarni graduated from Atherton High School, earned a bachelor's and a master's degree in business administration from the University of Louisville, and received a J.D. from the University of District of Columbia School of Law.

Her career experience includes working as founder and managing attorney of Indus Law Firm, and her organizational affiliations include Louisville Public Media, the Community Foundation of Louisville, the Rotary Club of Louisville, and the Greater Louisville International Professionals.
Kulkarni succeeded Democrat Dennis Horlander in District 40 and defeated Patrick Dunegan in the 2026 Democratic primary.

In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Economic Development & Workforce Investment, House Judiciary, Licensing, Occupations, and Administrative Regulations, and Small Business & Information Technology committees.

In a 2018 Ballotpedia survey, she listed her top priorities as new revenue sources and progressive tax reform, protecting public and human services programs, and reforming voter disenfranchisement and sentencing laws.
